T.topic_fa: همان محصول، لحظه‌ی تازه: رشد با عوض‌کردن «کِی»، نه «چه»
T.topic_en: Same product, new moment: growing by changing when people use you, not what you sell
T.central_tension_fa: همه فکر می‌کنیم برای رشد باید محصول یا مشتری تازه پیدا کنیم؛ جیف چیزی در شیشه عوض نکرد، فقط ساعتِ باز کردنش را عوض کرد.
T.central_tension_en: We think growth needs a new product or new customers; Jif changed nothing in the jar, only the moment you open it.
T.working_hook_fa: توی شیشه هیچ چیز عوض نشد. فقط ساعتش عوض شد.
T.working_hook_en: Nothing in the jar changed. Only the clock did.

key_sources.claim: First major design update in 30+ years; tri-colour banner revived, drop shadow removed; packs show snack uses (apple, celery, rice cake, cracker); Jif To Go renamed Jif Dippers; squeezable formats; core product unchanged; new packs ship from October 2026.
Refresh aims to extend Jif beyond PB&J into snacking; cites Spins: 56% of Americans replacing conventional meals with snacks or smaller meals (third-party figure, original not read).
Redesign centres on 'snack inspiration'; packs reach shelves through autumn and early winter 2026.
Category entry points = moments when someone mentally enters a category; linking a brand to relevant cues raises mental availability; more CEPs do not automatically mean more growth.

T.framing_note: News is the spark (packs arriving on shelves this month); the reel is about the evergreen move: find a new usage moment before chasing a new product. Facts: core product unchanged (company claim), new imagery shows snack uses, Jif To Go -> Jif Dippers, squeezable format, drop shadow removed. Do NOT claim the refresh has increased sales (no results yet). Use at most one number (56% snacking, attributed to Spins via FoodNavigator, in caption) or none. Name 'category entry points' only in caption with Ehrenberg-Bass/Jenni Romaniuk and their caveat. Persian reel: add a local-feeling everyday example (e.g. a product tied to one moment like tea after lunch) without naming any country or city. Last slide gives the viewer a test: 'list the three moments your customer reaches for you; find the fourth.' No logos generated by AI; real Jif pack only from owner upload.

image_requests.description: عکس اصلی خبر: خانواده‌ی بسته‌بندی‌های تازه‌ی جیف (شیشه‌ها و قالب‌های جدید) کنار هم؛ همان عکس بالای صفحه‌ی خبر را ذخیره کن (Jif-Family_August-2026.jpg).
image_requests.scene_idea: اثبات واقعی: «این‌ها همان شیشه‌اند، با تصویر لحظه‌های تازه روی برچسب» — قاب‌دار روی صحنه‌ی تیره پس از قلاب.

image_requests.description: لوگوی تازه‌ی جیف (بنر سه‌رنگ بدون سایه) از همان صفحه‌ی خبر (Jif-Logo_Aug-2026.jpg؛ عکس لوگو در صفحه).
image_requests.scene_idea: «سایه را پاک کرد، بنر را نگه داشت»: پاک‌کن از روی لوگو رد می‌شود = چهره تمیز شد، نشانه‌های آشنا ماند.

object_plan.object: generic unlabelled glass jar of peanut butter with a spoon in it
object_plan.line_idea: Hook: nothing in the jar changed (same product)
The old moment: peanut butter as an ingredient inside a sandwich
Only the clock changed: the moment of use moved
The new moment: a snack, dipped, eaten on its own
Meals shrink into snacks (one attributed number or none)
Format follows the moment: squeezable pack for snacking on the go
Removed the drop shadow, kept the banner: clean the face, keep what people recognise
Positioning is a direction: point the product to a new moment
Persian/universal example: a product glued to one moment (tea after lunch) — which other moment could it own?
Look for the moments your customer already lives before inventing a new product
CTA test: write down three moments people reach for you; find the fourth
